question: What is the primary goal of routine immunization in primary health care?
explanation: Routine immunization targets infants and young children to build immunity against severe childhood infections. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h1)

question: How does achieving high immunization coverage protect vulnerable newborns?

options.A: By curing active infections before symptoms appear
options.B: By providing immediate long-term nutritional support
options.C: Through strengthening the infant's natural digestion
options.D: Through establishing herd immunity within the community

explanation: High population coverage stops the spread of pathogens, protecting infants too young for vaccination. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h1)

question: A major logistical barrier to immunization in rural Nigerian settlements is...

options.A: Excessive availability of cold storage units
options.C: Poor road networks and geographic isolation

explanation: Distant communities and bad roads prevent caregivers from reaching fixed health facilities. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h2)

question: Why does persistent misinformation about vaccine safety lower community coverage?

options.A: It increases the cost of purchasing imported biologicals
options.B: It forces nurses to close primary health centers permanently
options.C: It creates fear and widespread vaccine hesitancy among caregivers
options.D: It immediately destroys vaccines stored in cold boxes

explanation: False rumors erode trust, causing parents to refuse life-saving vaccines for their children. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h2)

question: Who is an effective local figure to involve when mobilizing rural communities for immunization?
explanation: Local leaders hold significant influence and command respect among community members. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h3)

question: A nurse notices high vaccine refusal rates in a specific village. What initial step should the nurse take?

options.A: Report all defaulting parents to local law enforcement
options.B: Stop visiting the community and wait for them to come
options.C: Increase the price of vaccines to reflect their high value
options.D: Engage community leaders to discuss and address local concerns

explanation: Working with respected community figures helps identify root causes of hesitancy and builds trust. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h3)

question: What is the standard temperature range for storing most routine vaccines in a refrigerator?
explanation: Standard vaccine refrigerators must be maintained between +2 degrees and +8 degrees Celsius to preserve potency. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h4)

question: What is the primary function of a Vaccine Vial Monitor (VVM) on a vaccine label?

options.A: Showing the exact manufacturing date of the liquid
options.B: Measuring the remaining volume of vaccine inside
options.C: Signaling when the vaccine expiration date has passed
options.D: Indicating if the vial has been exposed to excessive heat

explanation: VVMs change color progressively when exposed to heat, helping health workers identify compromised vaccines. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h4)

question: Why are mobile vaccination clinics essential in rural public health practice?

options.A: They bring healthcare services closer to geographically isolated populations
options.B: They reduce the cost of manufacturing new vaccine supplies
options.C: They completely eliminate the need for fixed health facilities
options.D: They prevent the requirement for cold chain maintenance

explanation: Mobile clinics overcome distance barriers, enabling hard-to-reach populations to access routine immunizations. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h5)

question: A nursing team is planning an outreach clinic to a remote island. What is a critical preparatory step?

options.A: Waiting for caregivers to request vaccines at the health post
options.B: Instructing villagers to travel to the main city hospital
options.C: Discontinuing all fixed facility operations for a month
options.D: Ensuring sufficient vaccine carriers and ice packs are packed

explanation: Maintaining the cold chain during transit is crucial to ensure vaccines remain potent upon arrival. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h5)

question: What defines an immunization defaulter in child health programming?

options.A: A newborn who has never visited a health facility
options.B: A child who started vaccination but missed subsequent scheduled doses
options.C: An infant who completed all mandatory immunizations
options.D: A caregiver who refuses to register a birth

explanation: Defaulters are children who drop out of the schedule before completing all recommended doses. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h6)

question: How do home-based immunization cards assist nurses in tracking missing infants?

options.A: They automatically send text message alerts to health workers
options.B: They function as monetary vouchers for clinic attendance
options.C: They provide a clear record of received and upcoming vaccine dates
options.D: They store electronic GPS coordinates of the child's home

explanation: The physical card shows exactly which vaccines the child has received and which ones are overdue. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h6)

question: Which tool is primarily used at the service delivery point to record daily immunizations?

options.B: Daily immunization register and tally sheets

explanation: Tally sheets and registers capture real-time administration data during vaccination sessions. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h7)

question: Why is calculating the immunization dropout rate important for a health facility?

options.A: It measures how many children fail to complete their scheduled doses
options.B: It determines the exact financial cost of purchasing syringes
options.C: It evaluates the cleaning schedule of the clinic refrigerator
options.D: It tracks the total number of staff members on duty

explanation: Dropout rates reveal the proportion of infants who start vaccination but do not finish the series. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T71#GNS214_U1_T71_h7)
